description: Perplexity Desktop on its own, because its macOS floor is higher than the other desktop casks'.
why: ai.perplexity.macv3 is Perplexity Desktop and ai.perplexity.comet is the browser. Two agents, one vendor, one bundle-id prefix -- so `perplexity-comet` is forbidden here rather than merely unlisted. Without that, a signature that matched the prefix instead of the id would classify this install as both and nothing would say so; 10-desktop-apps installs both together and so cannot ask the question.
known_gaps: Paid or account-gated in several cases. The install is unattended and the sign-in is not, so nothing exercises behaviour that only appears once a user is signed in.
